audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 0-4 disagree with the mirror, and whys[1], whys[4], whys[5] name the wrong stages.
audit.why: The mirror flipped Levels 2, 3, 4-5 and 6 to Heimerdinger as one atomic group with First item and 2+ items left to Yasuo. Row 0 is Yasuo per the packet and per whys[0] ('Level 1 goes to Yasuo'), but was stored as Skill. The prose also drifts a stage: whys[4] says 'Level 5' for the Level 6 row and whys[5] says 'Level 6' for the First item row.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 1, 2, 3, 4 flipped in both layers with ratings rescaled; whys[1], whys[3], whys[4], whys[5] rewritten to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: The single decisive interaction is only half-stated, and 'Last Breath converts ANY knockup' is false here.
audit.why: Every damage source Heimerdinger owns carries the projectile flag — turret beams, Micro-Rockets and the grenade alike — so one 4-second Wind Wall blanks his entire kit, not just 'turret beams'. The mirror states the same. His grenade stuns YOU, so it can never set up Last Breath; only your own two-stack Steel Tempest whirlwind does.
audit.corrected: Wind Wall described as answering beams, rockets and grenade together; Q2 whirlwind named as the only Last Breath setup.

edits.after: You own Level 1 before his turrets exist — Heimer is a squishy immobile mage you can walk onto and Q poke freely. Punish him then, because it gets much worse from level 2 once his kit lands.

edits.before: Levels 3-4 flip to Heimerdinger the moment his three H-28G Turrets (Q) and Micro-Rockets (W) blanket the lane — the beam zone denies CS and a naked dive melts you. Wall the volleys, chunk turrets, and wait; by Level 5 your crit components and E mobility let you dash through the turret line onto him again.
edits.after: Levels 2-6 belong to Heimerdinger the moment his H-28 G Evolution Turrets (Q) and Hextech Micro-Rockets (W, 11s at rank 1) blanket the lane — the beam zone denies CS and a naked dive melts you. Wall the volleys, chunk turrets, and wait for your first item before you try to cross the line.

edits.before: From 6 and beyond you're firmly ahead: Last Breath punishes any over-extend, and with items you dash turret-to-Heimer and delete him. Wind Wall his CH-2 grenade (E) stun so you aren't chained mid-dive, and only a defended UPGRADE! turret slows the kill.
edits.after: From your first item you're firmly ahead: Last Breath punishes any over-extend, and with items you delete him. Wind Wall the CH-2 grenade (E, 11s) so you aren't stunned mid-dive, and only a defended UPGRADE!!! turret slows the kill.

edits.after: Last Breath (70s at rank 1) fires only off your own Q2 whirlwind. UPGRADE!!! is 100s — an ulted turret is a wall, not a duel.

edits.before: Last Breath converts ANY knockup into a kill window — build your teamfight around that. Heimerdinger carry threat: 7/10 — shift to picks and wave control if he gets ahead.
edits.after: Last Breath needs an airborne target and only your own Q2 whirlwind supplies one. Heimerdinger carry threat: 7/10 — shift to picks and wave control if he leads.

edits.before: - Heimerdinger CH-2 Grenade: matchup-defining — His self-peel stun. Dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Heimerdinger CH-2 Grenade: 11s flat — his self-peel stun, and Wind Wall eats it. - Micro-Rockets is 11s at rank 1. Every damage source he has is a projectile. - Your ultimate: kill windows only.

edits.before: His self-peel stun. Dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: His self-peel stun, 11s flat — Wind Wall blocks it outright.
